status: accepted design catalog; operations are not implemented
notes: Names and consistency rules form the baseline. Concrete DTO/schema implementations are an M0 task.
Effect metadata is not an authorization decision.
Operation lookup is scoped to an authorized stable actor and document, independent of an expired connection epoch.
Native GUI edits may use typed command handlers; they still pass through the same application commit coordinator.
Host lifecycle intents survive lost create/open/close responses. OperationLookup supports host scope without a document ID and document scope with one.
